newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's invests $1.4 mln in garment unit.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's invests $1.4 mln in garment unit.

text.p: Morocco leading bank Banque Marocaine pour le Developpement Economique has granted 12.5 million dirhams ($1.4 million) loan to local subsidiary of British garment firm Albion Plc, the official MAP news agency said on Wednesday.
The loan is a part of an investment programme of 18.5 million dirhams aimed at establishing a garment industry units in Rabat area, MAP said.
The project, called Alyco II, will be operational in July 1997 and would provide jobs for about 270 Moroccans, it said.
The BNDE was involved in 1986 in a similar project Alyco I, in which the British firm holds 40 percent stake, it said.
Alyco II factory is expected to produce up to 180,000 articles per year destined to the European and Russian markets, the agency added.
BNDE, which is one of Morocco's 16 active banks, is set to be privatised in 1997.
